name: codex-china-travel-suite
description: Mainland-China trip planning with AMap, DiDi, Fliggy, and Meituan Travel integrations.

interface.shortDescription: Plan routes and compare live China travel inventory.
interface.longDescription: Combines AMap geographic checks, DiDi ride tools, and Fliggy and Meituan travel-product discovery in one Codex plugin.
defaultPrompt: Plan a relaxed mainland-China trip and verify every important POI and route with AMap.
Compare relevant Fliggy and Meituan travel products without booking them.
Estimate a DiDi ride, but ask for confirmation before placing or cancelling an order.
